name: zclass_is_initialized
description: zClass::IsInitialized returns the zClass initialization flag.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this getter; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass lifecycle source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4518f0 validates a direct load and return of g_zClass_IsInitialized with no direct callees.
The native smoke verifies zClass::IsInitialized returns zero before the flag is set and one after g_zClass_IsInitialized is set.
